name: dg_fno
description: Discrepancy-gated FNO. The LF ensemble's per-pixel uncertainty fields (mu, sigma, q10/q50/q90) MODULATE the HF residual operator instead of being concatenated: Gate A spatial FiLM on every block, Gate B a spectral mode-gate that opens the delta-operator's Fourier bands where LF error is high-frequency, and Gate C a heteroscedastic gain field so HF = mu_LF + rho(x)*delta. All gates zero-init, so it starts as an X-FiLM residual model (crossing mf_fno_transfer_film's injection with fno_fire_distcond's signal). Gates selectable via DG_GATES for ablation.
